title: DARPA special access program to reverse-engineer cephalopod camouflage

tellings.quote: mindblowing oh well my my special Access program um was trying to reverse engineer uh camouflage from spilop pods

plain: Around 2000, John Blitch ran a highly restricted secret project, the kind the military calls a special access program, to copy the camouflage of octopus and squid. He worked at DARPA, the Pentagon's agency for advanced research, and also says an alien once abducted him. He describes the work as his own, mentions the researchers Roger Hanlon, Benny Hochner and Tamar Flash alongside it, and tells it as an example of the military turning nature's tricks into technology.
